2609.24984.title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
2609.24984.paper_summary: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.
2609.24984.paper_summary_zh: 視頻世界模型使得互動探索動態環境成為可能，但在長時間範圍和不同視角下，卻難以尊重先前的觀察。我們提出了WorldCrafter，一種視頻世界模型，旨在學習一種可通過相機查詢的隱式3D感知記憶。關鍵的見解是讓請求的視角影響多視角證據如何壓縮到視頻生成器的有限標記預算中。與視頻生成器共同訓練的記憶編碼器和姿態條件讀取模塊在去噪之前，將歷史觀察整合到一組固定的目標視角特定標記中，而無需明確的深度對應。通過將這種記憶與近期的時間上下文和少步驟的蒸餾相結合，WorldCrafter使得從單一輸入圖像或文本提示中進行流式場景探索成為可能。在靜態和動態場景中的實驗顯示，在長時間範圍內的一致性和相機控制準確性方面有顯著提升，同時在分鐘級探索過程中保持了視覺質量。
